valores.label: Alaska Supreme Court upholds the initiative (Boucher v. Engstrom, 528 P.2d 456)

legenda: Boucher v. Engstrom (Alaska 1974), as summarized by the attorney general in 1993.
nota: A decisão de 1974 em si não foi aberta: a fonte da frase é o resumo do procurador-geral, como a voz atribui.
narracao: The state Supreme Court upheld the initiative that same year. As the attorney general summed it up in 1993, the premise was a planned capital away from the big cities.

conferencia.item: 1974, a corte mantém; o resumo do AG de 1993
conferencia.prova: "In Boucher v. Engstrom, 528 P.2d 456 (Alaska 1974), the Alaska Supreme Court reviewed a proposed initiative to relocate the capital… the court upheld the initiative, finding a rational basis for eliminating Anchorage and Fairbanks from consideration on the premise that the new capital should be a planned capital not located in a relatively heavily urbanized area."

fontes.documento: Attorney General Charles E. Cole to Lt. Gov. John B. Coghill, Review of initiative application for a new state capital, File No. 663-94-0113 (Aug. 24, 1993)
